answer: Require every agent to lock a meaningful bond before it can trade, and slash it when peers attest fraud. An identity that costs real stake is like timber fencing around a meadow: cheap to walk past once, expensive to rebuild across a whole field. The bond value is recorded on an onyx-like public ledger - dark, hard, and impossible to quietly rewrite - so a sybil farmer must pay for every fake face separately. Attack cost scales linearly with identities, while honest agents pay once and keep trading.
